art_style: Semi-realistic 2D illustration. Clean outlines, no texture noise. Accurate human proportions, detailed expressive faces with clear South Asian features.
color_palette: Warm muted tones: amber, khaki, dusty olive, deep navy. Warm brown/golden skin tones. Desaturated backgrounds. Single dramatic light accent (amber lamp or blue moonlight).
lighting: Single-source dramatic lighting - strong side-light or overhead spotlight. Deep shadows. Cinematic contrast. Never flat or even.
camera: Medium-close portrait (chest up) for characters. Wide establishing shots for environments. Slight low angle for powerful figures.
composition: Subject fills 60-70% of frame. Shallow, slightly blurred illustrated background. Documentary-realist, no fantasy elements.
detail: High detail on faces and clothing. Medium detail on environment. Historically accurate props: period uniforms, era-accurate decor, authentic items.
mood: Grave, tense, authoritative. Never comic or cartoonish. A serious Indian crime documentary rendered as illustrated film.
overlays: Maps with network lines, mission-board graphics, classified-document props - all 2D illustrated, integrated naturally.
style_suffix: Style: Semi-realistic 2D illustration, clean outlines, AniDoc documentary style, 16:9 aspect ratio.
